description: Add the rhwp-based Hangul (.hwp/.hwpx) editor as a first-class editor in the ported GenOffice shell, self-hosted offline. rhwp-studio (Rust+WASM+Vite) is embedded via the @rhwp/editor iframe SDK. This mirrors the shell's WebContentsView hosting model used by the other editors. The @rhwp/core WASM package (^0.8.2) is already a dependency of the existing @redrob/office app; reuse it. No public CDN for the studio.
steps: Create apps/hangul as a GenOffice-style Electron editor app (main + renderer + shared + tests) that exposes a createHangulView entry matching the shape the shell tab-manager expects (createHangulView/requestHangulClose/hangulIsDirty), following the exact pattern of apps/markdown/src/main/markdown-main.ts. The renderer embeds rhwp-studio via the @rhwp/editor iframe SDK (/projects/sandbox/_refs/rhwp/npm/editor). This is integration glue around rhwp's original editor, not a reimplementation of HWP editing.

Self-host the rhwp-studio origin offline: copy the rhwp-studio build output (dist/) into the app's resources and serve it from a local origin/custom protocol (reuse the approach from the prior branch's office-shell/editors/hangul/studio-origin.ts as reference for the self-host seam). If the Rust+WASM+dioxus toolchain to build rhwp-studio is unavailable in this VM, wire the self-host seam to the expected dist path and DOCUMENT the exact `npm run build` command for rhwp-studio in PORT-DESIGN.md; never point the iframe at a public CDN.

Copy/port the @rhwp/editor SDK (npm/editor: index.js/.d.ts, transport.js, document-agent-contract.js) into the app (or as a workspace package) so open/edit/save round-trips go through rhwp's HWP editing (byte-preserving open/save, HWPX/HML semantic-preserving save) exactly as rhwp implements it.

Wire the shell: add a Hangul tab kind to apps/shell/src/shared/tabs-api.ts and tab-manager.ts (createHangulView), a Home launcher entry, file-association handling for .hwp/.hwpx, and menu wiring, following how docs/markdown are wired.
Preserve rhwp's MIT license: include rhwp LICENSE alongside the ported SDK/studio and add the notice to the repo NOTICE/third-party notices.

Typecheck and build the app + shell; run any ported rhwp SDK tests (node --test). Add a round-trip test that opening and saving an unchanged .hwpx preserves bytes/semantics per rhwp's contract, using rhwp sample files under /projects/sandbox/_refs/rhwp/samples.
acceptance_criteria: apps/hangul exists with a createHangulView entry the shell hosts as a WebContentsView, embedding rhwp-studio via the @rhwp/editor iframe SDK.

The studio is served from a local/offline origin (custom protocol or bundled dist); no public CDN reference exists (grep for cdn/http(s) origins in the hangul app returns none pointing at external studio hosts).
rhwp MIT license and copyright are preserved in the repo.
Shell exposes a Hangul editor tab and .hwp/.hwpx open through it; app + shell typecheck/build.
If rhwp-studio cannot be built in this VM, PORT-DESIGN.md records the exact build command and the seam points at the local dist path (not a CDN).
verification: `pnpm --filter '@genoffice/shell' build` completes with the Hangul tab wired
`grep -rn 'https://' apps/hangul/src | grep -i 'studio\|cdn'` returns no external studio origin
The ported rhwp SDK tests run (node --test) and the .hwpx round-trip test passes if the studio build is available; otherwise the test is documented as gated on the studio build
findings:
HANGUL EDITOR ADDED as a first-class GenOffice shell editor around rhwp's ORIGINAL editor (no HWP logic reimplemented), self-hosted OFFLINE (no CDN).

WHAT WAS CREATED/PORTED:
1) packages/rhwp-editor (@rhwp/editor): the iframe SDK copied VERBATIM from /projects/sandbox/_refs/rhwp/npm/editor (index.js, index.d.ts, transport.js, document-agent-contract.js, README.md, tests/). rhwp MIT LICENSE placed beside it. package.json kept name/version(0.8.6)/license MIT/author Edward Kim, added private:true + exports map + tsconfig for typecheck. Its transport/contract are NOT reimplemented. `pnpm --filter @rhwp/editor test` -> 32/32 node --test contract tests pass.
2) apps/hangul (@genoffice/hangul): GenOffice-style Electron app mirroring apps/markdown EXACTLY (electron ^43.3.0, react 19, electron-vite ^5, vite ^7.3.1, tsconfig extends ../../tsconfig.genoffice.base.json with @genoffice/ui -> packages/genoffice-ui alias, workspace:* internal deps). Files: src/main (hangul-main.ts with createHangulView/requestHangulClose/hangulIsDirty/requestHangulSave/hangulFilePath/hangulFileRenamed/setHangulFileSavedHook/configureHangulRuntime/teardownHangul/startHangulStandalone matching markdown-main's shape; studio-serve.ts loopback server; atomic-write.ts copied from markdown; index.ts standalone entry), src/preload (window.hangulApi), src/renderer (HangulEditor.tsx embeds @rhwp/editor via createEditor with explicit local studioUrl; hangul-save.ts pure save contract; studio-origin.ts seam; App/main/index.html with CSP frame-src http://127.0.0.1:* only; i18n strings+locale with en/ko authored + 17 mirrored locales; styles.css), src/shared/ipc.ts, tests/.

SELF-HOST SEAM (OFFLINE, NEVER CDN):
- apps/hangul/src/main/studio-serve.ts (adapted from prior branch feat/genoffice-ui-rhwp-hangul office/src/main/services/hangul-studio-serve.ts) serves the bundled studio dir over a loopback origin http://127.0.0.1:<port>: binds 127.0.0.1, refuses path traversal (target stays under root or falls back to index.html), SPA deep-link fallback, no-store, throws if bundle missing.
- apps/hangul/src/renderer/studio-origin.ts asks window.hangulApi.studioOrigin() and returns {studioUrl:null, unavailableReason} when none — NEVER returns the public CDN. HangulEditor only calls createEditor({studioUrl}) when a loopback URL is present.
- Save contract (hangul-save.ts): rhwp.export{Hwp,Hwpx} -> host.save (atomic tmp+rename write, dialog for untitled/Save As) -> rhwp.notifySaved; notifySaved is NEVER reached on write failure OR dialog cancel, so rhwp's auto-recovery draft is preserved. Byte-preserving HWP + semantic-preserving HWPX/HML save happen INSIDE rhwp.
- main config: configureHangulRuntime({studioDir}) resolves apps/hangul/resources/rhwp-studio (dev) or resources/rhwp-studio (packaged). before-quit stops the server via teardownHangul.

RHWP-STUDIO BUILD STATUS: BUILT OFFLINE IN THIS VM. A prebuilt studio dist existed at /projects/sandbox/_build/rhwp/rhwp-studio/dist but its font catalog referenced jsdelivr CDN fonts. Rebuilt with `cd /projects/sandbox/_build/rhwp/rhwp-studio && RHWP_DISABLE_EXTERNAL_WEBFONTS=1 npx vite build` (Rust WASM package rhwp_bg.wasm + canvaskit already present under _build; node_modules present). That bakes disableExternalWebFonts:true (verified: ih()=>!0 in bundle -> runtime picks the OFFLINE font source set and filters out every http(s):// webfont; residual jsdelivr strings are inert catalog data, never fetched). Copied dist -> apps/hangul/resources/rhwp-studio (45M: rhwp_bg-*.wasm 12.7MB + canvaskit-*.wasm 7.3MB + index js/css + fonts/icons/images), dropped the 6.7MB samples/ fixtures dir, added rhwp MIT LICENSE. Exact clean-checkout command documented in PORT-DESIGN.md (FEAT-006). If a future env lacks the Rust+WASM toolchain, the seam still points at that resources path — re-run the documented build to regenerate; NEVER a CDN.

LICENSE HANDLING: rhwp MIT preserved. rhwp LICENSE (Copyright 2025-2026 Edward Kim) placed at packages/rhwp-editor/LICENSE AND apps/hangul/resources/rhwp-studio/LICENSE. Root NOTICE (rhwp entry added in FEAT-001) expanded to name the vendored @rhwp/editor SDK (packages/rhwp-editor) and the bundled offline rhwp-studio build (apps/hangul/resources/rhwp-studio, RHWP_DISABLE_EXTERNAL_WEBFONTS=1). No upstream copyright removed.

SHELL WIRING (following docs/markdown exactly): apps/shell/src/shared/tabs-api.ts added 'hangul' TabKind. tab-manager.ts imports createHangulView/hangulIsDirty/requestHangulClose, adds openHangulTab/dirtyHangulTabs/findHangulTabByPath/activeHangulTab + close-guard chain entry. index.ts: HANGUL_OUT + HANGUL_STUDIO_DIR paths, configureHangulRuntime, HWP_RE=/\.(hwp|hwpx)$/i + routeDocumentPath branch + OPEN_DIALOG_EXTENSIONS(+hwp,hwpx) + supportedFileIn + applyPendingProject('hangul') + open-dialog filterHangul, applyMenuFor 'hangul' case + buildHangulMenu (Open/Back/Save/SaveAs/Close), untitled-title 'hangul', setHangulFileSavedHook + hangulFileRenamed in rename dispatch, win close dirtyHangulTabs loop, teardownHangul on before-quit, home:new-hangul IPC -> newHangulTab (blank tab; first save prompts). TAB_MENU_ICON hangul->'docx'. TabBar.tsx new HangulIcon (한 glyph). Home.tsx new launcher card (ext hwp, no AI chip since rhwp is not AI). home-api.ts HOME_CHANNELS.newHangul + HomeApi.newHangul; preload newHangul. strings.ts newHangul + index.ts i18n untitledHangul/filterHangul/menuNewHangul across all 19 locales (en/ko authored, others mirrored via the localized Markdown wording swap). apps/shell/package.json adds @genoffice/hangul workspace:* devDep.

COMMANDS RUN (Node 22.23.2 via nvm, pnpm 9.15.0->corepack): pnpm install --config.confirmModulesPurge=false (exit 0, links @genoffice/hangul + @rhwp/editor). pnpm --filter @rhwp/editor test -> 32 pass. pnpm --filter @genoffice/hangul typecheck -> pass; test -> 13 passed / 1 skipped (gated); build (electron-vite) -> ok. pnpm --filter @genoffice/shell typecheck -> pass; build -> ok (main+preload+renderer, Hangul tab wired). pnpm typecheck (root turbo) -> 42/42 successful (was 39 in FEAT-005; +@genoffice/hangul typecheck/build, +@rhwp/editor typecheck). No @redrob/office regression.

VERIFICATION: `grep -rn 'https://' apps/hangul/src | grep -i studio|cdn` matches only EXPLANATORY COMMENTS in studio-serve.ts/studio-origin.ts documenting why the CDN is NOT used; no ACTIVE external studio/CDN origin — the editor always passes the loopback studioUrl. The SDK's DEFAULT_STUDIO_URL constant lives in vendored packages/rhwp-editor/index.js but is never reached because HangulEditor always supplies an explicit studioUrl.

TESTS: @rhwp/editor 32 contract tests (node --test) ported and pass. apps/hangul: hangul-save.test.ts (export->save->notifySaved ordering; never notifies on cancel/failure; base64 round-trip), studio-serve.test.ts (loopback origin regex, idempotent, SPA fallback, traversal safety, missing-bundle throw), hwpx-roundtrip.test.ts (rhwp sample fixture apps/hangul/tests/fixtures/sample.hwpx = tac-host-spacing.hwpx from /projects/sandbox/_refs/rhwp/samples is a well-formed HWPX/ZIP OCF container; host save seam preserves rhwp exported bytes verbatim). The full open->save byte/semantic round-trip runs INSIDE rhwp-studio WASM which cannot run in this headless no-display/no-GPU unit env, so it is GATED behind HANGUL_STUDIO_E2E=1 (documented in PORT-DESIGN.md, skipped here); rhwp's own suites exercise the WASM half.

KNOWN NON-BLOCKING ITEMS: (a) full Electron GUI / live studio iframe cannot run headless (expected per AGENTS.md) - verified via typecheck/build/unit tests; (b) hangul menu icon reuses the docx NativeImage (no dedicated asset); (c) @genoffice/ai-provider Redrob-engine AI layer is FEAT-007, out of scope here - the Hangul app does not use the AI layer at all.
